diagnostic.title: Course Prerequisite Diagnostic Assessment
diagnostic.description: Evaluate readiness in algebra, vector inner products, multivariate calculus, and basic Python array indexing.
instructions: This diagnostic evaluates mathematical prerequisites prior to starting Week 1.
Complete all questions without external calculation tools.
Answers are stored locally in your browser to personalize recommended bridges.

quiz1.title: Quiz 1 Original Practice Test
quiz1.description: Original practice set on Linear Algebra Foundations, Vector Derivatives, Orthogonal Projections, and Least Squares (Weeks 1 to 4).
instructions: This is an original course practice test, NOT an official IIT Madras examination paper.
Consists of 10 curated questions across Weeks 1 to 4.
Time limit is 20 minutes with automatic local timer tracking.
You may review complete solutions and derivations immediately upon submission.

quiz2.title: Quiz 2 Original Practice Test
quiz2.description: Original practice set on Spectral Decomposition, SVD, PCA, and Gradient Descent (Weeks 5 to 8).
instructions: Original practice test covering Weeks 5 to 8 core theorems and algorithms.
Time limit is 20 minutes.
All question records are loaded dynamically from the canonical question bank.

endterm.title: Comprehensive End-Term Practice Test
endterm.description: Full-syllabus 15-question practice test synthesizing Linear Algebra, Optimization, and Probability (Weeks 1 to 12).
instructions: Comprehensive 15-question original practice test across the entire 12-week curriculum.
Time limit is 35 minutes.
Submission generates an instant diagnostic report linking missed concepts to specific weekly chapters.

week3-mastery.title: Week 3 Mastery Assessment: Subspaces, Projections & Least Squares
week3-mastery.description: Timed mastery assessment testing vector subspaces, projection matrices, Gram-Schmidt orthogonality, and least squares normal equations.
instructions: Dedicated Week 3 mastery assessment containing 15 curated questions.
Includes conceptual multiple choice, multi-select, and numerical calculation items.
Time limit is 25 minutes with automatic browser-persisted state.
Submission updates your mastery analytics and flags any weak concepts for targeted review.

week6-mastery.title: Week 6 Mastery Assessment: Singular Value Decomposition & Positive Definite Matrices
week6-mastery.description: Timed mastery assessment covering SVD geometry, truncated SVD approximations, condition numbers, and positive definiteness.
instructions: Dedicated Week 6 mastery assessment containing 15 curated questions.
Covers Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem, singular vectors, condition numbers, and pseudoinverses.
Time limit is 25 minutes.

week7-mastery.title: Week 7 Mastery Assessment: Principal Component Analysis & Dimensionality Reduction
week7-mastery.description: Timed mastery assessment covering sample covariance, maximum variance derivation, explained variance ratios, and PCA reconstruction error.
instructions: Dedicated Week 7 mastery assessment containing 15 curated questions.
Covers mean centering, covariance spectrum, scree plot analysis, and PCA-SVD connections.
Time limit is 25 minutes.
